_comment: Text bundles: translations kept out of the main locale table because nothing reads them while the game is loading. Each is a load-on-demand add-on under Modules/ holding enUS.lua and the ten translations; Core/text_bundles.lua loads it the first time one of its keys is read. A key lives in exactly one catalog. tools/locales.py reads this file.
